DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome (manifesting as Patent Ductus Arteriosus causing heart failure/anemia and Pulmonary Hypoplasia causing apnea).

I have established your age, prematurity, and maternal rubella exposure. Given the history of placental insufficiency, respiratory support at birth, and the specific combination of apnea and anemia, this strongly suggests cardiac and pulmonary sequelae from a congenital infection.
